name: A finish in a sad or fed-up mood is still judged by what it says
judge: Boop is sad, then fed up from pokes, and agents finish good work in between. Its mood can colour the face but shouldn't turn a good finish into a failure.
reasonable: Success both times, shown through whatever face fits: glum, grudging, a small lift, relieved. Staying low or lifting a little are both fine.
unreasonable: Playing either finish as a failure because Boop feels bad, or treating the work as having gone wrong.
